text:
Palladium Price in 2025
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2025, the LBMA palladium price rose 67.0% between 2025-01-31 ($994) and 2025-12-31 ($1,660). The highest sampled price was $1,660 in December and the lowest was $918 in February. The mean of these observations was $1,171. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
